name: JW Electrical Supply
old_description: JW Electrical Supply is a Maryland-based distributor of industrial and commercial electrical supplies, shipping nationwide from Baltimore. Stock covers circuit breakers, fuses, safety switches, motor starters, connectors, transformers and bus plugs, in new, used, surplus and hard-to-find obsolete equipment. Customers are electrical contractors, industrial facilities, maintenance teams and MRO buyers sourcing replacements for legacy gear that is no longer in production.
about:
JW Electrical Supply operates from Baltimore, Maryland, where it was founded in 1977. The company remains a privately held distributor of industrial and commercial electrical products, shipping nationwide from its Maryland headquarters. Leadership includes President Wajahat Ashai and Head of Marketing and Operations Suhail Kamran, though the original founders are not identified in public materials.

The firm stocks circuit breakers, fuses, safety switches, motor starters, connectors, transformers, and bus plugs from manufacturers such as Square D, General Electric, Appleton, Mersen, and Eaton. Inventory spans new, used, open-box surplus, and hard-to-find obsolete items, supporting both new installations and legacy system maintenance. Orders are fulfilled through an e-commerce platform with a small team of 1–10 employees; facility size and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers include electrical contractors, industrial facilities, and MRO buyers across the United States. Testimonials cite projects for contractors such as Titan Electrical Contractors in Houston, Crown Manufacturing in Cleveland, and GreenTech Industrial Solutions in Atlanta, as well as plant engineers at Allied Equipment in Detroit and utility personnel at Northern Utility Services in Seattle. The company also serves HVAC, power systems, and commercial construction sectors.

The company states its mission is to eliminate supply-chain headaches by providing dependable delivery, responsive technical support, and cross-referencing expertise for hard-to-source parts. Since its founding, it has emphasized on-time shipping as a standard rather than a goal, and positions itself as a partner for both routine procurement and emergency legacy replacements.
